Bullet 3.25, commit 2c204c49e56ed15ec5fcfa71d199ab6d6570b3f5
https://github.com/bulletphysics/bullet3/tree/3.25

Unmodified BulletCollision, BulletDynamics and LinearMath, their amalgamation
translation units and common headers. Statically linked into ref_gl; no DLL,
installer, online build dependency, or managed runtime is required.
LICENSE.txt preserves the upstream zlib license. Source outside these three
libraries is omitted. This subset is project source, not release content.
